claims.location: experimental design and exact RAW mapping
claims.value: Three Q Exactive HF-X acquisitions from juvenile mouse testes: two anti-DICER immunoprecipitations and one rabbit-IgG control.
claims.evidence: PRIDE protocol, complete deposited file inventory, and accession-linked primary record; 3 of 3 RAW basenames covered exactly once.

limitations: The paper establishes 17-18-day-old mouse testes but does not expose individual animal identifiers; all rows therefore retain one unsplit biological source, while IP1/IP2 are technical replicates of the anti-DICER condition.
The local quality scorer flags the evidence-backed age range 17D-18D even though the annotation rules permit hyphenated age ranges.
